definition: A set of practices combining machine learning, DevOps, and data engineering to reliably build, deploy, monitor, and maintain ML models in production.
details: MLOps addresses the full lifecycle of ML systems, including versioning of data and models, automated testing, continuous integration/deployment, and monitoring for issues like drift or degraded performance.
story: Picture a librarian organizing a million slips of paper so that any one of them can be found in a heartbeat. The examples a machine reads become the world it believes in. Better ingredients make a better meal, and the same is true here. Garbage in, garbage out — and the reverse: clean, representative data makes the model quietly brilliant. That care with the raw material is MLOps.
